objectifs: Say which one is the best

etapes.fr: Pour comparer : adjectif court + -er + than. Adjectif long : more + adjectif + than.
etapes.en: Abidjan is bigger than Bouaké. This phone is more expensive than that one.

etapes.fr: Le superlatif (le plus…) : the + adjectif-est, ou the most + adjectif long.
etapes.en: It's the biggest city. It's the most beautiful beach.

etapes.fr: Attention aux irréguliers : good → better → the best ; bad → worse → the worst ; far → further → the furthest.

exemples.en: It was the worst day of my life!
exemples.fr: C'était le pire jour de ma vie !

lignes.en: This one is cheaper, but that one is faster.
lignes.fr: Celui-ci est moins cher, mais celui-là est plus rapide.

lignes.en: Which one has the best camera?
lignes.fr: Lequel a le meilleur appareil photo ?

lignes.en: The second one. It's the most expensive, but it's the best.
lignes.fr: Le deuxième. C'est le plus cher, mais c'est le meilleur.

etapes.en: Abidjan is more crowded than Grand-Bassam
etapes.fr: Abidjan est plus bondée que Grand-Bassam
C'est le pire restaurant de la ville.
reponses: It's the worst restaurant in the city.
It is the worst restaurant in the city.
It's the worst restaurant in town.

etapes.en: My brother is taller than me.
choix: Mon frère est plus grand que moi.
Mon frère est plus petit que moi.
Mon frère est aussi grand que moi.

etapes.en: Rice is cheaper than meat, but meat is more delicious!
etapes.fr: Le riz est moins cher que la viande, mais la viande est plus délicieuse !

resume: short adj + -er than / more + long adj than. the + -est / the most. good-better-best, bad-worse-worst.
devoir: Compare two cities you know with 5 sentences.
